known_runtime_gap.finding: The existing settlement-aligned live path uses Chainlink for the whole BTC momentum detector as well as fair value, which is broader than the frozen candidate.
known_runtime_gap.action: Do not reuse that live switch as evidence for settlement_source_anchor_v1. A dedicated default-off runtime implementation may be considered only after two disjoint forward block passes.

next_authorized_use.future_settlement_anchor_block: allowed only after the preregistered disjoint allocation rule selects its first condition

remaining_allocation_control.reason: The candidate block cannot be allocated until the binary-complement hierarchy seals its controlling condition set.
remaining_allocation_control.implemented_control: The wrapper hash-pins the exact 750 allowed IDs, fixed report partition, public strikes, candidate and prior condition-set artifacts, preregistration, frozen variant, boundary-specific prior-block shape, and three single-use score outputs; it revalidates all source hashes, chronology, sealing, and overlap before replay data access.
remaining_allocation_control.required_before_first_candidate_score: Issue one concrete passing lock from the future sealed condition set; no lock exists while the active binary-complement block controls allocation.

remaining_pairing_control.required_before_first_candidate_score: Run the implemented scorer only after the future block is sealed, its label-free source audit passes, and the allocation lock's reserved report/trade paths exist while its reserved pair-audit path remains unused. The scorer then verifies exact condition, report-partition, catalog, raw-input, latency, fill, fee, and replay parity; only the fair-value tape may differ.
